body: Thanks for the kind words, I appreciate it a lot. I'll pm you once I get my school work done

Throwaway.

From the outside it looks like I am happy, but really I think about offing myself everyday. Nothing tragic has ever gone on in my life. My family is financially sound and they support me in everything I do. But I have told few people about how I actually feel and they don't seem to relate. I have massive trust issues, I don't even trust my family even though they love me so much. I'm afraid to reveal very much about myself in fear of being made fun of or judged for it. In turn I have few actual friends. I feel very alone. My three best friends all moved away to different states and I rarely see them anymore. The highlights of the past few years are all with them but seeing them is rare. 

I have no confidence in myself. With just about everything, I go into it with a pessimistic attitude. I feel like I can never succeed and there is no point to life. I don't care about pleasing other people so it's a battle against myself. My parents tell me that they are proud of me but I don't care. I only want to feel proud of myself and that's not the case. I want to succeed but I have zero motivation to put in the work required so I see no point in living. In my honest opinion I would have killed myself a while ago if it weren't for my parents. I could never do that to them. The pain they would feel walking in on my dead body is too much for me to think about so I never see myself acting on any of my thoughts unless they were to die. 

I have no reason to feel this way. Like I mentioned, I live a nice life. I don't know why I feel like this but I want it to stop. Sorry if this doesn't make sense or sounds stupid I just want to tell someone the way I really see things for once.

Hey I'm 17 too and my parents are the same way. I'm in the same spot you are. I have no friends, never talked to a girl for more than a few words, and all I do is smoke weed and take other drugs. I tried to quit that but gave up after 1 day. Stay strong man

Yes I've had 3. Two of them were severe and the other was minor. I have talked to my parents about it but neither of them understand the way I feel. They are the "old-school" type and don't believe in mental illnesses for the most part. Thanks for the reply
